title: Polynomial content: the scalar pull-out

located_defect.lean_text: def LocalClaim : Prop := ∀ (a : ℤ) (p : ℤ[X]), (C a * p).content = a * p.content
located_defect.description: The source (stored lines 0010-0011) pulls the integer scalar a out of the content: cont(b n q f) = a cont(n f), i.e. cont(a p) = a cont(p) for the integer polynomial p = n f. As a universal statement over all integers a and all p ∈ ℤ[X] this is the located defect. Supply the corrected scalar factor and prove the corrected identity for every a and p; there is no separate target theorem beyond the corrected statement.

/-!

namespace ProofWiki25056Census

-- ===== FIXED PART: only the hole «HOLE» may be edited =====
/-- The corrected scalar factor `s a` in `(C a * p).content = s a * p.content`, as an expression in the
integer `a` (the source has `a` itself). No reference to `content`; no `if`/`match`. -/
def scalar_factor (a : ℤ) : ℤ := «HOLE»

/-- The corrected pull-out identity for every integer scalar and every integer polynomial (shape fixed;
`Polynomial.content` is Mathlib's normalised gcd of the coefficients). -/
def CorrectedClaim : Prop :=
  ∀ (a : ℤ) (p : Polynomial ℤ), (Polynomial.C a * p).content = scalar_factor a * p.content
-- ===== END FIXED PART =====

end ProofWiki25056Census
